PRE-TECHNICAL STUDIES — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #14
====

GRADE: Grade 7
SUBJECT: PRE-TECHNICAL STUDIES
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KJSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. When learning Non- Metallic Materials, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Skip safety briefings for Non- Metallic Materials.
   B. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Non- Metallic Materials.
   C. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Non- Metallic Materials.
   D. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Non- Metallic Materials.

2. Before using a sharp tool in a workshop, you should: (1 mark)
   A. Remove all guards
   B. Work alone with eyes closed
   C. Wear safety gear and follow instructions
   D. Run with the tool

3. A computer’s main brain for processing is the: (1 mark)
   A. Keyboard
   B. CPU
   C. Speaker
   D. Monitor

4. When learning Measuring and Marking Out Tools 18 4.2 Computer Hardware 8 5.0 Entrepreneurship , the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Measuring and Marking Out Tools 18 4.2 Computer Hardware 8 5.0 Entrepreneurship .
   B. Skip safety briefings for Measuring and Marking Out Tools 18 4.2 Computer Hardware 8 5.0 Entrepreneurship .
   C. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Measuring and Marking Out Tools 18 4.2 Computer Hardware 8 5.0 Entrepreneurship .
   D. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Measuring and Marking Out Tools 18 4.2 Computer Hardware 8 5.0 Entrepreneurship .

5. When learning Introduction to Materials, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Introduction to Materials.

   C. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Introduction to Materials.
   D. Skip safety briefings for Introduction to Materials.

6. When learning Introduction to Pre-Technical Studies, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Introduction to Pre-Technical Studies.
   B. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Introduction to Pre-Technical Studies.
   C. Skip safety briefings for Introduction to Pre-Technical Studies.
   D. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Introduction to Pre-Technical Studies.

7. Electricity safety rule: (1 mark)
   A. Never touch live wires with wet hands
   B. Overload every socket
   C. Ignore burnt cables
   D. Insert metal objects into sockets for fun

8. When learning ICT Tools in Communication, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Skip safety briefings for ICT Tools in Communication.
   B. Leave sharp tools on the floor after ICT Tools in Communication.
   C. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for ICT Tools in Communication.
   D. Guess wiring or cutting steps for ICT Tools in Communication.

9. When learning Computer Concepts, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Computer Concepts.
   B. Skip safety briefings for Computer Concepts.
   C. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Computer Concepts.
   D. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Computer Concepts.

10. When learning Safety in the Immediate Environment, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Skip safety briefings for Safety in the Immediate Environment.
   B. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Safety in the Immediate Environment.
   C. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Safety in the Immediate Environment.
   D. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Safety in the Immediate Environment.

11. When learning Measuring and Marking Out Tools, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Measuring and Marking Out Tools.
   B. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Measuring and Marking Out Tools.
   C. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Measuring and Marking Out Tools.
   D. Skip safety briefings for Measuring and Marking Out Tools.

12. When learning Introduction to Drawing, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Introduction to Drawing.
   B. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Introduction to Drawing.
   C. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Introduction to Drawing.
   D. Skip safety briefings for Introduction to Drawing.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. In three clear sentences, explain Non- Metallic Materials and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain Measuring and Marking Out Tools 18 4.2 Computer Hardware 8 5.0 Entrepreneurship  and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
